items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Exceptions
items.description: Fork-specific exceptions including TransactionTypeError, TransactionGasLimitExceededError (EIP-7825), BlobGasLimitExceededError, BlobCountExceededError, InitCodeTooLargeError, and others.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Fork (Entry Point)
items.description: Main fork entry point. Defines state_transition, validate_header, apply_body, check_transaction. Includes constants: MAX_BLOCK_SIZE=10MiB (EIP-7934), MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE=8MiB, BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT=6. Implements calculate_base_fee_per_gas and calculate_excess_blob_gas.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Fork Types
items.description: Core type definitions for Osaka fork: Account, Address, Root, VersionedHash, Bloom, Authorization, encode_account, and EMPTY_ACCOUNT.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Requests
items.description: EIP-7685 request framework. Defines deposit, withdrawal, and consolidation request types. Implements extract_deposit_data, parse_deposit_requests, and compute_requests_hash (SHA2-256).

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- State
items.description: State management for Osaka fork. Defines State and TransientStorage classes, account CRUD operations, storage operations, state snapshotting (begin/commit/rollback_transaction), and state_root computation.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Transactions
items.description: Transaction types for Osaka: LegacyTransaction, AccessListTransaction, FeeMarketTransaction, BlobTransaction, SetCodeTransaction. Defines TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT=16,777,216 (EIP-7825), TX_BASE_COST=21000, FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST=10, and transaction encoding/decoding/validation.

items.title: Osaka Execution Spec -- Trie
items.description: Merkle Patricia Trie implementation for Osaka fork. Defines Trie, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode, trie_set, trie_get, root computation, nibble encoding, and EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT.
